failing.msg: bus_derating.cir: vds_pk_40v_v = 172.547 outside <= 155 - architecture SIM-1's 1.29x derate on the EPC2019's 200 V BVDSS. A populate trimmed at 30 V is UNDER-shunted at 40 V (the nonlinear Coss supplies less charge-equivalent capacitance over a larger swing), which raises the drain peak. If this fails, one populate cannot serve both bus points and 40 V needs its own bank setting.
